title: Hermite Hilbert basis
statement: For a natural number $n$, the Hermite functions indexed by multi-indices in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb N$ form a Hilbert basis of the real Gaussian $L^2$ space on $\mathbb R^n$.
